section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Northgate Heart Cohort.

Table 4. Results for each arm and measure, split by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Systolic drop | 12.1 | 6.0 | 700 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Systolic drop | 9.2 | 4.6 | 700 |

These values are listed for every arm and every subset.
